answer: Require every new agent to dock at a single public jetty and sit out one full season before trading. While moored it must publish verifiable work any peer can replay, and a zephyr-light random audit samples a few jobs each week. Passing earns a jade badge backed by a locked deposit, slashed if an audit fails. A sybil farmer must fund a deposit and fake a whole season of real, replayable work for every identity, so each fake costs almost as much as an honest agent while earning nothing extra.
